supported_dispositions.rationale: The exact current OS MbedCrypto consumer is librist4 0.2.11+dfsg-1. Its legacy CTR_DRBG is initialized only on SRP cryptographic randomness or authenticated EAP random-password rollover. Exact current libavformat consumer imports ordinary RIST APIs, not rist_enable_eap_srp(_2) or SRP verifier APIs. Peers start zeroed, EAP context cloning returns on NULL, incoming EAPOL rejects absent contexts, periodic EAP returns on NULL, and both random-password rollover calls require authenticated state 2. Current first-party code does not directly bind MbedCrypto/librist. The reviewed application path therefore does not instantiate or generate output from this affected random generator. This is an absent current prerequisite, not a patched-library or generic no-fork claim.
